title: Dichter Rundstrauch A
description: Mehrstämmiger, unregelmäßig gewölbter Uferstrauch. Elf gebogene Grundtriebe verzweigen sich rekursiv zu feinen Endzweigen mit kleinen opaken Blattsprays; dunkles Innenlaub und warme helle Olivspitzen gliedern die dichte Krone.

review.notes: Round 1, closest in this PR: it fails only on material. Good: 2.6 x 2.2 m, an airy irregular dome, multiple stems visible at the base, modelled leaves with light/dark variation, it reads well next to the figure. Defect (material 7): the leaves are dark teal/blue-green and the shaded interior goes nearly black, not the dark olive of foliage_leaf with warmer olive tops. Shift the hue toward olive (less blue), lift the sunlit tops and keep the interior dark green rather than black. Minor: the stems converge into one point at the ground like a broom; spread the stem bases a little and add leaf litter or soil at the base.
